gloss: to enjoy (as a pastime); to have refined taste in; to be well-mannered

definitions.gloss: to enjoy (as a pastime); to have refined taste in; to dabble in
definitions.explanation: To enjoy or practice something as a hobby or cultivated pursuit, often implying modest skill. Frequently used when humbly describing one's own hobbies.

definitions.gloss: to be well-mannered; to exercise self-restraint; to be proper
definitions.explanation: To behave in a restrained, dignified, and socially appropriate manner. This sense often appears in the form たしなみ (noun).

examples.japanese: ⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧{頃|ころ}、⟦{茶道|さどう}→茶道：04451_sadou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧たしなんで⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: When I was young, I dabbled a little in tea ceremony.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{囲碁|いご}→囲碁：18035_igo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧たしなむ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧で、⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{碁|ご}→碁：02138_go⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}っている→打つ：01221_utsu⟧。
examples.english: My father is someone who enjoys go, and he always plays on weekends.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧{頃|ころ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{書道|しょどう}→書道：04178_shodou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧たしなんで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother has practiced calligraphy since she was young.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社会人|しゃかいじん}→社会人：13730_shakaijin⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧たしなみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: To have the proper decorum expected of a working adult.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧たしなみ⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦{最低限|さいていげん}→最低限：13056_saiteigen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦マナー→マナー：11139_manaa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧につけておきたい。
examples.english: As a matter of adult decorum, I want to have at least basic manners.

notes:
USAGE:
- Sense 2 lives on mostly in the noun たしなみ (decorum, a cultivated accomplishment) and in ⟦{身|み}だしなみ→身だしなみ：14286_midashinami⟧ (grooming); the verb itself is now used almost only in sense 1.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{酒|さけ}→酒：02211_sake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧たしなむ: to drink (moderately/with refinement)
- ⟦{茶道|さどう}→茶道：04451_sadou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧たしなむ: to practice tea ceremony (as a hobby)
- ⟦{俳句|はいく}→俳句：00083_haiku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧たしなむ: to enjoy composing haiku
- ⟦{身|み}だしなみ→身だしなみ：14286_midashinami⟧: personal grooming/appearance
- ⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧たしなみ: adult decorum/refinement

WRITING:
Can be written as {嗜|たしな}む, but the kanji is uncommon and hiragana is more typical.

REGISTER:
Slightly literary and refined. Saying one たしなむ a pursuit sounds modest ("I dabble in") and more cultivated than ⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧〜です.
